prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: text-free illustration plate for a 185 x 240 mm paperback cover.
Input image is the EDIT TARGET, the approved Cover C artwork. This is a careful restoration/adaptation, not a new illustration concept.
Remove ALL lettering: "Vegetable", "Growing", "CHEAT SHEETS", and "Practical advice. At a glance." Remove the orange rounded text banner too. Inpaint only the areas previously hidden by these words/banner, giving a pale warm apricot central field into which new editable type will be placed later.
PRESERVE the recognisable existing vegetable artwork with maximum fidelity: the long diagonal bright orange carrot with its faceted highlights and dense green tops across the upper edge, the cut-open purple onion with fine purple concentric layers at bottom left, the shiny red tomato at right, the open curving green pea pod with round peas at bottom right, and all large green leaves. Maintain their original shapes, orientation, proportions, crisp contours, colours and layered vector-like editorial style. Do not replace them with botanical watercolour or differently shaped vegetables. Reconstruct the carrot behind the removed text, but keep the central area predominantly pale apricot so dark green title text is readable there.
Adapt the composition gently from the narrow A4 original to the wider 185:240 book proportion without stretching vegetables. Keep the onion and pea pod low and the tomato on the right. Retain the pale apricot irregular rounded panel behind the centre. Preserve transparency outside the existing illustration and panel. No text, no numbers, no badges, no page previews, no new vegetables or objects, no border, no mockup.
Output high resolution, ideally 2304 x 2976 pixels.
notes: Working derivative. Lettering/banner removed, hidden areas reconstructed and proportions adapted. The original illustration remains intact. Reconstructed carrot curves more than the partly hidden original; review continuity before final high-resolution preparation.
